title: Black Breeze by Chubby Juice E-Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
Black Breeze Shortfill E-Liquid:
Immerse yourself in the bold and captivating blend of juicy blackcurrant and ripe blackberries, balanced perfectly with a refreshing menthol twist. The subtle yet unmistakable touch of aniseed adds a unique depth to this flavour profile, creating a layered and satisfying sensation with every puff. Whether you’re a fan of rich berries or crave a cool and invigorating finish, Black Breeze delivers a harmony of fruity sweetness and frosty refreshment that’s hard to resist.
Product Features
Brand:
Chubby Juice
Brand Origin:
UK
Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid.
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavoured E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free.
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine shots have been added – Tap here for our nic shot calculator.)
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
